Public Function Reads(ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ch As Object, s As String, v As Variant, i As Long, j As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    On Error Resume Next
    For i = 1 To wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects.Count
        Set ch = wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(i).Chart
        s = s & "#" & i & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.ChartType
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.ChartGroups.Count
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes.Count
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.HasAxis(1, 1)
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.HasAxis(2, 1)
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.HasAxis(1, 2)
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.HasAxis(2, 2)
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.SeriesCollection.Count
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.ColumnGroups.Count
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.LineGroups.Count
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.AreaGroups.Count
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.ChartGroups(1).AxisGroup
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.ChartGroups(1).GapWidth
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.ChartGroups(1).SeriesCollection.Count
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.ChartGroups(2).AxisGroup
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.ChartGroups(2).GapWidth
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.ChartGroups(2).SeriesCollection.Count
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.ChartGroups(2).SeriesCollection(1).Name
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(2, 2).AxisGroup
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(2, 2).HasTitle
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(2, 2).AxisTitle.Text
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(2, 2).MaximumScaleIsAuto
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(2, 2).Crosses
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(2, 2).HasMajorGridlines
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(2, 2).TickLabelPosition
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(1, 2).Crosses
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(1, 2).AxisGroup
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(1, 1).AxisGroup
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(2, 1).AxisGroup
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        v = "E": Err.Clear
        v = ch.Axes(2, 1).Crosses
        If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
        s = s & v & "|"
        For j = 1 To ch.SeriesCollection.Count
            v = "E": Err.Clear
            v = ch.SeriesCollection(j).Name
            If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
            s = s & v & "|"
            v = "E": Err.Clear
            v = ch.SeriesCollection(j).ChartType
            If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
            s = s & v & "|"
            v = "E": Err.Clear
            v = ch.SeriesCollection(j).AxisGroup
            If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
            s = s & v & "|"
            v = "E": Err.Clear
            v = ch.SeriesCollection(j).PlotOrder
            If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
            s = s & v & "|"
            v = "E": Err.Clear
            v = ch.SeriesCollection(j).Type
            If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
            s = s & v & "|"
            v = "E": Err.Clear
            v = ch.SeriesCollection(j).MarkerStyle
            If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
            s = s & v & "|"
            v = "E": Err.Clear
            v = ch.SeriesCollection(j).Formula
            If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
            s = s & v & "|"
        Next
    Next
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "#scale|" & wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1).Chart.Axes(2, 2).MaximumScale
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Reads = s
End Function
